title: Test Plan (metadata)
description: Validates plans/<plan_id>/plan.json. Conditions are not embedded here — each condition is a file at conditions/<TCON-id>.json, validated by test-condition.schema.json. The conditions/ directory is the authoritative condition list; the harness checks referential integrity (matching plan_id, filename and id, and a condition for every P0 requirement).

plan_id.description: Must match the plans/<plan_id>/ directory name — checked by the harness

component.description: Covered package or module, for example vn.tcbs.halo.matching

items.description: Path or ID of a source specification document

risk_tier.description: Assigned by harness routing and copied by the Designer — do not choose it independently

spec_gaps.description: Behavior missing from or ambiguous in the specification. Empty when none exist, but always present so the Designer must consider it.

description.description: What the gap is; when ambiguous, state both interpretations
